About Refill Enterprises

A young company with a clinical spine.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Nepal, Refill Enterprises exists to bring critical-care-grade nutritional science to the healthcare professionals and patients who need it.

Established
2020
Headquarters
Kathmandu, Nepal
Field
Nutraceuticals · Medical devices
Focus

01Who we are

Dynamic, emerging, and deliberately specialized.

Refill Enterprises Pvt. Ltd. is a nutraceutical company dedicated to serving the growing needs of healthcare professionals and patients with high-quality, science-based products in clinical and critical care nutrition — the progain enteral range for intensive care, renal, diabetic and paediatric states, re-pro daily protein, and calcium, antioxidant and curcumin supplementation designed to support recovery, rehabilitation, and overall patient well-being.

Beyond nutraceuticals, we introduce BAITONG ENFit-standard enteral delivery systems used exclusively in critical care nutrition — bridging the gap between modern healthcare technology and patient-centered nutritional care through strategic partnerships.

Next, as our long-term commitment: a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Nepal that strengthens domestic healthcare capability, quality assurance, self-reliance, and employment.

Vision

To become a leading nutraceutical and healthcare solutions company — recognized for innovation, quality, and commitment to improving lives through advanced nutritional science.

Mission

  • 01Provide evidence-based nutritional and healthcare solutions.
  • 02Improve patient outcomes and quality of life.
  • 03Support healthcare professionals with innovative products.
  • 04Introduce advanced medical devices and applications.
  • 05Build local manufacturing capability in Nepal.
  • 06Deepen the clinical catalogue across specialities.

03Innovation timeline

A short history, a long plan.

Founded in 2020 with a clinical portfolio first — every step since has been toward the same destination: manufacturing in Nepal.

  1. 2020

    Founded in Nepal

    Refill Enterprises Pvt. Ltd. established with a vision to enhance healthcare outcomes through nutritional science.

    Done

  2. 2021

    Critical care portfolio

    The progain enteral range reaches healthcare professionals — high-protein whey, low-protein renal and diabetic formulations.

    Done

  3. 2022

    Disease-specific formulations

    Portfolio deepens into hydrolysed peptide, paediatric and supplementation lines — Calcinine, Recal-M, Cardivit and Recure.

    Done

  4. 2023

    Medical devices & applications

    BAITONG ENFit-standard enteral delivery systems introduced through strategic partnership.

    Done

  5. Now

    Deepening the clinical catalogue

    Nine products across enteral nutrition, supplementation and enteral delivery — supplied to hospitals and prescribing clinicians across Nepal.

    Active

  6. Next

    Manufacturing in Nepal

    A state-of-the-art domestic facility — quality assurance, self-reliance, employment, and a stronger Nepali healthcare industry.

    Planned
